name: pr-shadow-observer
description: Shadow-mode observer for pull-request autonomy: every 30 minutes, record what the autonomy gate would do with each open PR (risk tier, CI, whether it would auto-merge) and settle the PRs that were merged or closed. Read-only toward GitHub (gh pr list|view|checks); it never merges, comments or edits a PR. Read the result with `pnpm kyberion pr shadow-report`. Opt-in: needs the gh CLI authenticated on the host, so enable it with KYBERION_CHRONOS_SCHEDULES=pr-shadow-observer-30min.
